resources.string: See where you are at a glance
The chat header shows the folder, the Git branch and how many files changed. Tap it to review the changes.
The chat header shows the folder, the branch and the number of changed files; tapping it opens the list of changed files.
Try the app without a server
No server yet? Tap Try without a server on the Connect screen and look around with sample sessions. Nothing leaves your phone.
On the Connect screen a tap on Try without a server opens a list of sample sessions.
List and chat side by side
On unfolded foldables and tablets the sessions and the chat share the screen. Drag the divider to resize the list, or choose the split view in Settings.
A wide screen shows the session list next to the chat. Tapping a session updates the chat, and dragging the divider widens the list.
Share to OpenCode from any app
Send text, links and images from other apps to OpenCode in the share sheet, and start a new session from them.
A page is shared from another app; picking OpenCode in the share sheet starts a session with the shared link.
Settings you can see change
Change settings from a list, with live previews of the chat or in the demo. You see the result before you leave.
Dragging the chat text size slider enlarges the text of a live preview of the chat.
Know what changed before updating
When a new release is out, a sheet shows the changelog with the new features and fixes. Update, skip it or decide later.
An update sheet opens; tapping View changelog expands the list of new features and fixes.
Control your MCP servers
See which MCP servers are connected and connect or disconnect them from the chat menu, without going back to your computer.
The MCP servers sheet lists each server with its status; turning a switch on connects the server.
Follow the agent live
While the agent works, its current step stays open: you read thinking, command output and diffs as they arrive, and it folds back when the answer ends.
A chat shows the running command output, then the diff of an edit, and folds the steps when the answer arrives.
Tune tool output and text size
Choose how many lines of output to show, how often a running command refreshes and the chat text size. One button resets everything.
The refresh interval and the number of output lines are changed, then Reset all settings restores the defaults.
